Class ObjectNode

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.settings.node.NodeValue<Object>
com.saicone.settings.node.NodeKey<Object>
com.saicone.settings.node.ObjectNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
SettingsNode, com.saicone.types.AnyIterable<Object>, com.saicone.types.AnyObject<Object>, Iterable<Object>
public class ObjectNode extends NodeKey<Object> implements com.saicone.types.AnyIterable<Object>
Class to handle normal object as settings node.
This object can be inherited in enhanced for loop.
